package distributionchecks

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	nativetest "github.com/l-programming-language/l/internal/testsupport/native"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"testing/fstest"

	distribution "github.com/l-programming-language/l"
	"github.com/l-programming-language/l/lerrors"
	Logiceme "github.com/l-programming-language/l/logiceme"
	Lyger "github.com/l-programming-language/l/lyger"
)

func read(t *testing.T, filesystem fs.FS, path string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := fs.ReadFile(filesystem, path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resource %s: %v", path, err)
	}
	return data
}

func snapshot(t *testing.T) fstest.MapFS {
	t.Helper()
	result := fstest.MapFS{}
	err := fs.WalkDir(distribution.Files(), ".", func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !entry.IsDir() {
			result[path] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: append([]byte(nil), read(t, distribution.Files(), path)...)}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return result
}

func document() []byte {
	return []byte("<PROGRAM><STRUCTURE><BOOK \"rust_distribution_probe\"><OUTLINE>" +
		"<JSON>{\"AppMeta\":{\"AppGenDir\":\"/src\"}}</JSON>" +
		"<JSON>{\"Services\":[{\"Name\":\"main\",\"Location\":\"/src/\",\"GenericObjects\":[\"main\"]}]}</JSON>" +
		"<JSON>{\"Objects\":[{\"Name\":\"main\",\"Type\":\"root\"}]}</JSON>" +
		"</OUTLINE><SETTINGS></SETTINGS><CONTENT><CHAPTER \"main\"><SENTENCE \"main\"><|W|>" +
		"<|S|>`A`</S|><|S|>`FW{|Key: ~main~, Outputs: ~&[()]&~|}^W^BOD^E{|Statement: ~::std::print!(\"probe\");~|}`</S|>" +
		"</W|></SENTENCE></CHAPTER></CONTENT></BOOK></STRUCTURE></PROGRAM>")
}

func TestDistributionAPI(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("FS05", func(t *testing.T) {
		before, err := os.Getwd()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		input := []byte("Use IO's Print from `io` as \"Print\".\nCreate \"Hello\" as a New Basic App.\nThe App Prints `Hello World!`.\nExecute Hello.\nShow Hello's Output.\n")
		project := t.TempDir()
		main := filepath.Join(project, "main.l")
		if err := os.WriteFile(main, input, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		result, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{}).Compile(input, main)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		units, err := result.ApplicationUnits()
		if err != nil || len(units) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("units=%v %v", units, err)
		}
		bundle, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(nil).Evaluate(units[0].BackendAML, Logiceme.GenerationOptions{})
		if err != nil || len(bundle.ByteArrays) != 1 || len(bundle.ByteArrays[0]) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("same-resource Rust backend=%v", err)
		}
		after, err := os.Getwd()
		if err != nil || after != before {
			t.Fatalf("CWD=%q/%q %v", before, after, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("FS13", func(t *testing.T) {
		bundle, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(nil).Evaluate(document(), Logiceme.GenerationOptions{})
		if err != nil || len(bundle.ByteArrays) != 1 || len(bundle.ByteArrays[0]) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("embedded Rust backend=%v", err)
		}
		buildBundle(t, bundle)
	})
	t.Run("FS15", func(t *testing.T) {
		data := document()
		if err := os.MkdirAll("programs", 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile("programs/external.aml", data, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		scanner, err := Logiceme.LoadScanner("external.aml")
		if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(scanner.ProgramBytes, data) {
			t.Fatalf("explicit external Rust AML=%q %v", scanner.ProgramBytes, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("ReleaseInventory", func(t *testing.T) {
		root := os.DirFS(os.Getenv("L_DISTRIBUTION_ROOT"))
		var paths []string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(t, root, "testdata/distribution/resources.json"), &paths); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, path := range paths {
			if !fs.ValidPath(path) || seen[path] {
				t.Fatalf("invalid/duplicate release resource %q", path)
			}
			seen[path] = true
			if strings.Contains(path, "testdata") || strings.Contains(path, "draft") || strings.HasSuffix(path, "_test.go") || strings.HasPrefix(path, "configurations/") {
				t.Errorf("nonrelease resource %q", path)
			}
		}
		for _, path := range []string{"lexicon/eng/grammar.json", "lexicon/eng/vocabulary.json", "builtins/eng/core.l", "stdlib/index.json", "stdlib/eng/io/dictionary.l", "builtins/templates/runtime/runtime.lu", "builtins/templates/runtime/process_unix.lu", "builtins/templates/runtime/process_other.lu"} {
			if !seen[path] {
				t.Error(fmt.Sprintf("missing required Rust release resource %s", path))
			}
		}
	})

	t.Run("FS06", func(t *testing.T) {
		var expected []string
		root := os.DirFS(os.Getenv("L_DISTRIBUTION_ROOT"))
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(t, root, "testdata/distribution/resources.json"), &expected); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := fstest.TestFS(distribution.Files(), expected...); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var actual []string
		err := fs.WalkDir(distribution.Files(), ".", func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if !entry.IsDir() {
				actual = append(actual, path)
				if !bytes.Equal(read(t, distribution.Files(), path), read(t, root, path)) {
					t.Errorf("embedded bytes differ: %s", path)
				}
			}
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sort.Strings(actual)
		sort.Strings(expected)
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("release inventory=%v want=%v", actual, expected)
		}
	})
	t.Run("FS07", func(t *testing.T) {
		filesystem := snapshot(t)
		exact := []byte("\r\n雪 `literal` \\ quote\"\r\n\r\nlast")
		for _, path := range []string{"fixture/source.l", "fixture/template.lu", "fixture/lexicon.json"} {
			filesystem[path] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: append([]byte(nil), exact...)}
		}
		for _, path := range []string{"fixture/source.l", "fixture/template.lu", "fixture/lexicon.json"} {
			if got := read(t, filesystem, path); !bytes.Equal(got, exact) {
				t.Errorf("resource bytes changed: %s %q", path, got)
			}
		}
		// Exercise actual dictionary, literal, definition and backend readers,
		// not just a MapFS read-back. The exported value has significant CRLF,
		// blank lines, escaped backticks, Unicode and no terminal newline.
		want := "first\r\n雪 `literal`\r\n\r\nlast"
		ioPath := "stdlib/eng/io/dictionary.l"
		ioSource := append([]byte(nil), filesystem[ioPath].Data...)
		ioSource = append(ioSource, []byte("\r\nDefine IO's \"FixtureText\" as `first\r\n雪 \\`literal\\`\r\n\r\nlast`.\r\n")...)
		filesystem[ioPath] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: ioSource}
		runtimePath := "builtins/templates/runtime/runtime.lu"
		runtimeBytes := append(append([]byte(nil), filesystem[runtimePath].Data...), []byte("\r\n// exact template 雪 `literal`\r\n\r\n// no final newline")...)
		filesystem[runtimePath] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: runtimeBytes}
		input := []byte("Use IO's Print from `io` as \"Print\".\r\nUse IO's FixtureText from `io` as \"message\".\r\nCreate \"Hello\" as a New Basic App.\r\nThe App Prints message.\r\nExecute Hello.")
		requireLibraries(t, filesystem, input)
		result, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: filesystem}).Compile(input, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "main.l"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("selected-source byte preservation prerequisite: %v", err)
		}
		if result == nil || result.Compilation == nil || !bytes.Equal(result.Compilation.MainBytes, input) || result.Compilation.Prepared == nil || !bytes.Equal(result.Compilation.Prepared.Original, input) {
			t.Fatal("main source bytes normalized")
		}
		units, err := result.ApplicationUnits()
		if err != nil || len(units) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("source units: %v", err)
		}
		bundle, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(filesystem).Evaluate(units[0].BackendAML, Logiceme.GenerationOptions{IncludeRuntime: true})
		if err != nil || len(bundle.ByteArrays) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("source byte generation: %v", err)
		}
		foundLiteral, foundRuntime := false, false
		for i, name := range bundle.MapArrays[0] {
			data := bundle.ByteArrays[0][i]
			if strings.HasSuffix(name, "/runtime.rs") {
				foundRuntime = true
				if !bytes.Equal(data, runtimeBytes) {
					t.Fatal("runtime template bytes normalized")
				}
			}
			if !strings.HasSuffix(name, "/main.rs") {
				continue
			}
			quoted, err := json.Marshal(want)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			// Literal encoding and the selected borrowed dispatch are exact source
			// observations, not a replacement source oracle or a Go AST approximation.
			call := append([]byte(`(&&LPrintValue(&(`), quoted...)
			call = append(call, []byte(`))).l_print();`)...)
			if bytes.Count(data, call) != 1 || bytes.Count(data, []byte(`).l_print();`)) != 1 {
				t.Errorf("native Rust literal changed: want %q in %s", call, data)
			} else {
				foundLiteral = true
			}

		}
		if !foundLiteral || !foundRuntime {
			t.Fatal("byte preservation evidence missing from actual generated bundle")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FS08", func(t *testing.T) {
		options := Lyger.Options{}
		service := Lyger.NewLygerService(options)
		options.Language = "mutated"
		options.Resources = fstest.MapFS{}
		if _, err := service.Compile([]byte("Show `isolated|`."), filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "main.l")); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("caller options mutation reached service: %v", err)
		}
		expected, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(nil).Evaluate(document())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var wait sync.WaitGroup
		for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
			wait.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wait.Done()
				service := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(nil)
				bundle, err := service.Evaluate(document())
				if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(bundle, expected) {
					t.Errorf("parallel default generation differs: %v", err)
					return
				}
				bundle.ByteArrays[0][0][0] ^= 1
				fresh, err := service.Evaluate(document())
				if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(fresh, expected) {
					t.Errorf("bundle mutation leaked into reused service: %v", err)
				}
			}()
		}
		wait.Wait()
	})
	t.Run("FS09", func(t *testing.T) {
		filesystem := snapshot(t)
		input := []byte("Show `control|`.\n")
		main := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "main.l")
		if _, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: filesystem}).Compile(input, main); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("valid grammar prerequisite; intended assertion not exercised: %v", err)
		}
		for _, path := range []string{"lexicon/eng/grammar.json", "lexicon/eng/vocabulary.json"} {
			damaged := snapshot(t)
			delete(damaged, path)
			_, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: damaged}).Compile(input, main)
			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) || !errors.Is(err, lerrors.IO) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), path) {
				t.Errorf("missing selected resource fell back or lost cause: %v", err)
			}
			for _, malformed := range []string{"", "{", "{} {}"} {
				damaged := snapshot(t)
				damaged[path] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte(malformed)}
				_, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: damaged}).Compile(input, main)
				if !errors.Is(err, lerrors.InvalidConfiguration) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), path) {
					t.Errorf("grammar %s: %v", path, err)
				}
			}
		}
		damaged := snapshot(t)
		grammar := string(damaged["lexicon/eng/grammar.json"].Data)
		// Alter an actual named grammar reference, keeping valid JSON.
		needle := "PHRASE.DECLARATIVE.TYPE"
		if !strings.Contains(grammar, needle) {
			t.Fatal("invalid-reference fixture target absent")
		}
		damaged["lexicon/eng/grammar.json"] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte(strings.Replace(grammar, needle, "PHRASE.MISSING.TYPE", 1))}
		_, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: damaged}).Compile(input, main)
		if !errors.Is(err, lerrors.InvalidConfiguration) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "missing") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "lexicon/eng/grammar.json") {
			t.Fatalf("invalid grammar reference: %v", err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("FS12", func(t *testing.T) {
		filesystem := snapshot(t)
		grammarPath := "lexicon/eng/grammar.json"
		filesystem[grammarPath] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: append(append([]byte(nil), filesystem[grammarPath].Data...), []byte("\r\n\t\r\n")...)}
		vocabularyPath := "lexicon/eng/vocabulary.json"
		vocabulary := string(filesystem[vocabularyPath].Data)
		if !strings.Contains(vocabulary, `"root": "show"`) {
			t.Fatal("selected-vocabulary fixture target absent")
		}
		filesystem[vocabularyPath] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte(strings.Replace(vocabulary, `"root": "show"`, `"root": "displayselected"`, 1))}
		source := []byte("Displayselected `environment|`.\n")
		if _, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: filesystem}).Compile(source, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "main.l")); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("selected vocabulary was not used: %v", err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(read(t, filesystem, "lexicon/eng/grammar.json"), filesystem["lexicon/eng/grammar.json"].Data) {
			t.Fatal("selected grammar bytes changed")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FS14", func(t *testing.T) {
		original := snapshot(t)
		t.Run("Cargo positive control", func(t *testing.T) {
			bundle, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(original).Evaluate(document(), Logiceme.GenerationOptions{})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			buildBundle(t, bundle)
		})
		for _, withRuntime := range []bool{false, true} {
			if _, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(original).Evaluate(document(), Logiceme.GenerationOptions{IncludeRuntime: withRuntime}); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("valid selected-FS prerequisite: %v", err)
			}
		}
		var paths []string
		for path := range original {
			if strings.HasPrefix(path, "builtins/segments/") || strings.HasPrefix(path, "builtins/templates/") {
				paths = append(paths, path)
			}
		}
		sort.Strings(paths)
		for _, path := range paths {
			t.Run(path, func(t *testing.T) {
				filesystem := snapshot(t)
				delete(filesystem, path)
				if strings.Contains(path, "/runtime/") {
					if _, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(filesystem).Evaluate(document(), Logiceme.GenerationOptions{}); err != nil {
						t.Fatalf("non-runtime generation read an optional runtime asset: %v", err)
					}
				}
				_, err := Logiceme.NewLogicemeService(filesystem).Evaluate(document(), Logiceme.GenerationOptions{IncludeRuntime: true})
				if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), path) {
					t.Fatalf("selected asset fell back or lost cause for %s: %v", path, err)
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("MG10", func(t *testing.T) {
		root := os.DirFS(os.Getenv("L_DISTRIBUTION_ROOT"))
		for _, name := range []string{"runtime.lu", "process_unix.lu", "process_other.lu"} {
			path := "builtins/templates/runtime/" + name
			if !bytes.Equal(read(t, root, path), read(t, distribution.Files(), path)) {
				t.Errorf("runtime template substitution: %s", path)
			}
		}
	})
}

// The source provider records production reads; no assets are substituted.
type tracedFS struct {
	fs.FS
	mu    sync.Mutex
	reads map[string]bool
}

func (f *tracedFS) Open(name string) (fs.File, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.reads[name] = true
	f.mu.Unlock()
	return f.FS.Open(name)
}
func requireLibraries(t *testing.T, filesystem fs.FS, source []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	traced := &tracedFS{FS: filesystem, reads: map[string]bool{}}
	result, err := Lyger.NewLygerService(Lyger.Options{Resources: traced}).Compile(source, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "main.l"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Rust selected-library positive control: %v", err)
	}
	if result == nil {
		t.Fatal("Rust selected-library positive control returned no compilation")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"builtins/eng/core.l", "stdlib/eng/io/dictionary.l"} {
		if !traced.reads[name] {
			t.Errorf("production frontend did not select Rust source %s; negative/runtime assertion not reached", name)
		}
	}
	if t.Failed() {
		t.FailNow()
	}
}

// Compile the complete actual returned project, with its own manifest; the only
// added input is the independently retained initial dependency lock.
func buildBundle(t *testing.T, bundle Logiceme.Executable) {
	nativetest.RecordBundle(t, "selected-rust-api", bundle)
	t.Helper()
	if len(bundle.MapArrays) != 1 || len(bundle.ByteArrays) != 1 || len(bundle.MapArrays[0]) != len(bundle.ByteArrays[0]) {
		t.Fatal("invalid actual bundle")
	}
	files := map[string][]byte{}
	for i, path := range bundle.MapArrays[0] {
		name := strings.TrimPrefix(path, "/")
		if strings.HasSuffix(name, ".go") {
			t.Fatal("Rust bundle contains Go source")
		}
		if _, ok := files[name]; ok {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate path %s", path)
		}
		files[name] = bytes.Clone(bundle.ByteArrays[0][i])
	}
	files["Cargo.lock"] = read(t, os.DirFS(os.Getenv("L_DISTRIBUTION_ROOT")), "testdata/distribution/api/Cargo.lock")
	project := nativetest.Materialize(t, files)
	result := nativetest.Build(t, project, nativetest.BuildOptions{})
	if result.Err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual selected-Rust positive control Cargo failed: %v\n%s\n%s", result.Err, result.Stdout, result.Stderr)
	}
	if len(result.Artifacts) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("actual Cargo provenance: %+v", result.Artifacts)
	}
	nativetest.AssertNativeArtifact(t, result.Artifacts[0].Executable)
}
